features.name: Design Project Onboarding & Setup
features.description: Interview project concept, define brand archetype, set up design tokens in docs/design-system/DESIGN.md, and initialize designs/ canvas files.

features.name: Foundational Design System & Theme Variables
features.description: Establish color palette, typography scales, spacing tokens, and core reusable UI components (Buttons, Inputs, Cards, Nav) in designs/design-system.pen.

features.name: First User Flow Blueprint Wireframe
features.description: Convert initial planning doc/user story into a low-fidelity Blueprint Technical wireframe to validate structural layout before visual polish.

features.name: High-Fidelity Screen-by-Screen User Flow
features.description: Generate full UI screens for each interaction step, complete with directional connector arrows, gesture tags, and decision branches.

features.name: Interactive Prototype States & Preview Export
features.description: Model interactive component states (hover, active, sheet open, error toast) and export high-res PNG/PDF previews to docs/previews/.
